sanskrit: saṃsevyate parodharmaḥ te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1-13 ||
yatraiva dṛśyate liṅgaṃ sarvatīrthāni tatra vai || 1-14 ||
rudralokādihaṃ prāptāḥ te rudrāḥ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 1-17 ||
yat kṣaṇaṃ vā muhūrtaṃ vā śarvameko na cintayet || 1-19 ||
teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ janma kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ || 1-20 ||
saṃ viprendro muniśśrīmān sayatissa ca paṇḍitaḥ || 1-32 ||
tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa saṃpūjyo yathāhyaham || 1-36 ||
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati || 1-38 ||
sudurlabhaṃ śivaṃ jñātvā śive bhaktiṃ samāśrayet || 1-43 ||
teṣāndivā ca rātrau ca nityaṃ śivagatā smṛtiḥ || 1-44 ||
jihvāgre vartate yasya saphalaṃ tasya jīvitam || 1-45 ||
tasya pīṭhānna kurvanti tathā cānyepi hiṃsakāḥ || 1-48 ||
evamāha hariṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ ca haristathā || 3-3 ||
dakṣiṇe līyate brahmā vāme tasya janārdanaḥ || 3-15 ||
p. 11 (37) sthāpitaṃ tena sarvaṃ syāt pūjitaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 3-19 ||
pūrvaṃ liṅgaṃ samabhyarcya tadā kāryāṇi cakratuḥ || 3-20 ||
